segments.text:
V. 66.
They went and ſecured the ſepulchre, ſealing the ſtone, and ſetting a guard—They ſet Pilate's Signet, or the public Seal of the Sanhedrim upon a Faſtening which they had put on the Stone. And all this uncommon Caution was over-ruled by the Providence of GOD, to give the ſtrongeſt Proofs of Chriſt's enſuing Reſurrection; ſince there could be no Room for the leaſt Suſpicion of Deceit, when it ſhould be found, that his Body was raiſed out of a new Tomb, where there was no other Corpſe, and this Tomb hewn out of a Rock, the Mouth of which was ſecured by a great Stone, under a Seal, and a Guard of Soldiers.
